timing_quantiles: floor(p*(n-1)); across observation-class medians unless all_repetitions is stated
identifiability_weighting: uniform over all 65,536 truth worlds; also stratified by true slab count; inference always uses full A1 vocabulary

run.memory_scope: whole process including corpus, families, allocator and output buffers; not solver-only; -1 means unavailable
run.timing_scope: exact_supports from original domains, including input copy, allocations, witness construction and internal checks; excludes result destruction, compilation, oracle, external validation and CSV I/O

suites.name: restricted
suites.identifiability_note: No population fractions: these are seeded restricted/altered instances, not a truth prior. Empty-family row counts of zero are not identification claims.

comparison_limit: A0/A1 timings use different populations and algorithms. Historical Python uses different sampling, implementation, repetitions and environment. No controlled language speedup or scalability claim.
